candidates.title: `Slot` throws when a lazy child resolves to another lazy child (regression left over from #3165 / #3680, likely also #4082)
candidates.reason: Nested Flight lazy render failure; no working accessible last-good release or declared keyboard regression established.

candidates.title: Regression in terms of localization strings/i18n bundling in the latest release
candidates.reason: Locale bundle-size/tree-shaking regression; strings remain included, no primary user-facing accessibility symptom.

candidates.title: DateField UX regression in entering some dates
candidates.reason: Two exploratory reproductions with identical original criteria and dependency locks; accessible outcome and CSS-only twin match good/broken/fixed behaviour. DR-0098 adds test regression, benign twin and unchanged control; confirmatory execution awaits a new tag.

candidates.title: useComboBox: "Too many re-renders" infinite loop with inline children (regression in react-aria 3.47.0?)
candidates.reason: Merged fix #9781 for initial render loop; needs compatible pinned release boundary and an accessible complete last-good construct/keyboard scenario. The reported example only renders a bare input.

candidates.title: [TextField] regression inputStyle color not working
candidates.reason: Input text colour styling; primary vocabulary does not score colour/contrast.

candidates.title: Typescript regression from 1.0.0-beta.6 to 1.0.0-beta.7
candidates.reason: TypeScript compilation failure across beta releases; no stable accessible user-facing keyboard pair.

candidates.title: v0.20.1 REGRESSION AutoComplete : Enter key doesn't fire onNewRequest
candidates.reason: Keyboard issue is concrete, but closed as v0.x unmaintained with no library fix (P22 rule 6).

candidates.title: DetailsList: accessbility: Enter not working on links.(Regression)
candidates.reason: Enter activates row handler instead of cell link; maintainer says fixed in new release, but exact merged fix and last-good/broken pair remain unidentified.

candidates.title: Drop down: regression of DropDown not opening up when rendered at bottom of its containter
candidates.reason: Callout placement/available visual space; intentional change and no reported AT keyboard outcome. Linked #3719 is an issue, not a merged fix.
